text: )Ko woni, ɓe skkki sikkin e fiyaake ko Muhammadu addi kon (yo Alla juulu e makko hisna), tuma goo ɓe wi'a: "Ko koyɗi jillondirɗi firo alanaa ɗi".Tumo goo kadi ɓe wi'a: "Wanaa non, ko woni, o fefindi ɗi, ɗi maraa lasili". Tuma goo kadi ɓe wi'a: "Kanko ko o yimoowo, awa si tawii o laatike goonguɗo e nodditagol makko ngol yo o addan men kaawa- seeji, yeru tuggordu Muusaa ndun, e Naaqawa Saalihu mban".
